title: Kinetic Energy of the Car
text: The kinetic energy of the car is given by $$KE=\tfrac12mv**2$$.

title: Calculate the Required Rotational Energy
text: Since $$95.0\%$$ of the flywheel's rotational energy is used to accelerate the car, $$E_{\text{rot}}=\frac{KE}{0.950}.$$ What is $$E_{\text{rot}}$$ to three significant figures (in $$\text{J})$$?

title: Formula for the Moment of Inertia
text: The flywheel is a disk, so its moment of inertia is $$I=\tfrac12mr**2$$.

title: Relate Rotational Energy to Angular Velocity
text: Set $$E_{\text{rot}}=\tfrac12I\omega**2$$ and solve for $$\omega$$ in $$\text{rad/s}.$$ Then convert to rpm with $$\text{rpm}=\frac{60\, \omega}{2\pi}$$.
